items.quote: 6:2 And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD: 6:3 And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
items.claim: The text says God spoke to Moses and called himself the LORD. It also says God had appeared to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob under the name God Almighty, and that they did not know him by the name JEHOVAH.
items.mechanism: self-revelation by divine name (God Almighty vs. JEHOVAH)
